findings.source_quote: καὶ θέλουσιν ἐθελοδιδάσκαλοι εἶναι, ἄφρονες ὄντες.
findings.english_quote: and want to be teachers of their own choosing, though they are foolish.
findings.issue: “Teachers of their own choosing” introduces a choice of teachers or teacher-type rather than clearly conveying their desire to assume the teaching role themselves. The compound characterizes the aspiring teachers, not teachers selected by them.
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “and want to set themselves up as teachers, though they are foolish.” Review this candidate against the compound and its context before adoption; it need not imply any institutional appointment procedure.

findings.source_quote: τινὲς δὲ μετενόησαν καὶ ἐπίστευσαν καὶ ὑπέταξαν ἑαυτοὺς τοῖς ἔχουσι σύνεσιν, γνόντες τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀφροσύνην.
findings.english_quote: Context requires altered conduct, including abandoning grudges or pride. Preserve conditions and the stated life/death consequences.
findings.issue: The lexical rationale imports grudges, which this selected section does not mention. It also calls death a stated consequence, whereas the section explicitly contrasts living to God with dwelling with the women who work evil against them. That latter assertion should not be replaced or described as an explicit death statement.
findings.suggested_revision: Limit the rationale to this section’s pride, recognition of folly, belief, and submission to those with understanding. Describe the consequences using the source’s actual contrast: living to God versus dwelling with the women who work evil against them.

findings.issue: The sentence drops both the explicit reference to many from this group and the inferential connection expressed by οὖν. It reports rejection without preserving its stated connection to the preceding account.
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “So many of these people were rejected.” Review the replacement in context before adoption.

findings.source_quote: τινὲς δὲ μετενόησαν καὶ ἐπίστευσαν καὶ ὑπέταξαν ἑαυτοὺς τοῖς ἔχουσι σύνεσιν, γνόντες τὴν ἑαυτῶν ἀφροσύνην.
findings.english_quote: Context requires altered conduct, including abandoning grudges or pride. Preserve conditions and the stated life/death consequences.
findings.issue: The lexical rationale introduces grudges absent from this section and describes death as expressly stated. The actual adverse consequence is dwelling with the women who work evil against them, not an explicit statement of death.
findings.suggested_revision: Use a section-specific rationale addressing pride, recognition of folly, belief, and submission. Preserve the actual conditional consequences without relabeling the adverse outcome as stated death.

findings.source_quote: καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς δὲ τοῖς τοιούτοις κεῖται μετάνοια· οὐκ ἐγένοντο γὰρ πονηροί, μᾶλλον δὲ ⸢μωροὶ⸣ καὶ ⸢ἀσύνετοι. οὗτοι οὖν ἐὰν⸣ μετανοήσωσι, ζήσονται τῷ Θεῷ· ἐὰν δὲ μὴ μετανοήσωσι, κατοικήσουσι μετὰ τῶν γυναικῶν τῶν πονηρευομένων εἰς αὐτούς.
findings.english_quote: Preserve repentance conditions, confession, mercy and healing, and the declared foolishness, childlikeness/gentleness and spirit/seed alternatives.
findings.issue: This unit’s simplification metadata claims preservation of material and alternatives belonging elsewhere. Confession, mercy, healing, childlikeness/gentleness, and spirit/seed are not present in the selected section. The supplied report locates the latter alternatives in S.9.xxiv, not S.9.xxii.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace this with a unit-specific description of the sentence simplifications, repentance conditions, difficult assertions, and disclosed foolishness/wickedness textual issue. Remove claims about material from other sections.

summary: Both editions need limited revisions. Their main texts preserve the strong negations, repentance conditions, and difficult assertions, and the foolishness note accurately reflects the supplied bounded report without claiming unanimous manuscript support. The standard has an unclear rendering of the aspiring-teacher compound; the simplified loses an explicit inferential connection. Both contain inaccurate contextual metadata, with additional cross-section material in the simplified record. Proposed corrections require fresh review. This assessment concerns the supplied working source and reports, not authentication of unseen manuscripts or exhaustive collation.
